set.body: Scope: PRD Phase 1. Add axis-safe indices, runtime domain identities, ResponseSchema, ResolvedResponseSelection, an owned row-major ResponseBlock, ReadResult, provenance and receipt references, and a pure-plan/effectful-execute ResponseSource contract. Adapt the current ResponseBlockSource and DatasetBackend without moving latent or archive logic. Acceptance: in-memory and NIfTI selected reads are unchanged; order and shape laws pass; equal-shaped wrong-domain selections fail; current public duplicate rejection is preserved; ownership is explicit; JVM and Scala.js gates pass. Stop if the kernel must import archive, dataset hierarchy, or concrete representations.
set.title: RRA 1: establish the neutral response kernel and live adapters
